criteria.rationale: The recorded birth date makes the patient 28 years old on the request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescriber plans Wegovy for obesity.

The recent notes describe trying to eat better and be more active, food choices, and some walking. They do not establish a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity to be continued alongside Wegovy.
The weight follow-up notes do not document participation in a comprehensive program with the required components and continuing follow-up for a continuous six months.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 35.0 kg/m², exceeding the primary threshold of 30.

missing_requirements: Documentation that Wegovy will be used with both a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.
Documentation of at least six continuous months of participation in a comprehensive weight management program with diet, physical activity, and continuing follow-up.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, and BMI meet policy requirements. The supplied notes do not establish the required diet-and-activity plan or six months of comprehensive program participation, so the request is not ready for approval.
